headline: Code Changes & Accelerated Review goes before Board of County Commissioners Meeting on Wednesday, September 16
blurb: A full agenda for the September 16 BOCC. The commissioners continue their discussion of Constitutional Amendments 81 and 86 — touching immigration enforcement communication and congressional redistricting. A notable land-use matter: a Memorandum of Understanding with Telluride Mountain Village and the Ridge HOA regarding view plain restrictions from a 1999 settlement agreement.
